prompt_text: Which residential pest control companies are the most reputable in the Midwest US (Illinois, Ohio, Michigan)?
response_text:
When seeking reputable residential pest control services in the Midwest, particularly in Illinois, Ohio, and Michigan, consider the following companies:

**Rose Pest Solutions**  
Established in 1860, Rose Pest Solutions is the nation's oldest pest control company. They offer comprehensive residential services across Michigan, Ohio, and Indiana, addressing pests such as ants, bed bugs, cockroaches, mosquitoes, rodents, stinging insects, termites, and wildlife. With 16 local offices, they ensure prompt and personalized service. ([rosepestsolutions.com](https://www.rosepestsolutions.com/?utm_source=openai))

**Smithereen Pest Management Services**  
Serving the Midwest since 1888, Smithereen provides integrated pest management solutions for both residential and commercial clients. Their services cover a wide range of pests, including wasps, ants, rodents, mosquitoes, wildlife, cockroaches, spiders, and termites. They are also recognized for their bed bug removal and wildlife control services. ([smithereen.com](https://www.smithereen.com/?utm_source=openai))

**Franklin Pest Solutions**  
Operating since 1929, Franklin Pest Solutions offers pest control services in Illinois and Indiana. They provide year-round protection plans, including four home visits per year, to keep homes pest-free. Their services are tailored to protect families and properties from various pests. ([franklin.us](https://franklin.us/?utm_source=openai))

**Abell Pest Control**  
With over 32 years in business, Abell Pest Control offers services in Michigan, including cities like Ann Arbor, Battle Creek, Detroit, Flint, Grand Rapids, Kalamazoo, Lansing, Novi, Sterling Heights, Traverse City, and Waterford. They provide pest protection for both residential and commercial properties, addressing issues with ants, rodents, termites, and nuisance wildlife. ([abellpestcontrol.com](https://www.abellpestcontrol.com/en-us/locations/michigan?utm_source=openai))

**Delving Pest Control**  
Serving Northern Ohio and Southeastern Michigan for over 25 years, Delving Pest Control offers expert pest control, rodent remediation, and bed bug treatment. They provide discreet one-time treatments and no-contract ongoing plans for homes and businesses. ([delvingpest.com](https://www.delvingpest.com/pest-control-services/?utm_source=openai))

**Frame's Pest Control, Inc.**  
Since 1972, Frame's Pest Control has served Northern Ohio and Southeast Michigan with professional pest control services. They offer advanced methods and targeted treatments to eliminate unwanted pests from residential and commercial properties. ([framespestcontrol.com](https://www.framespestcontrol.com/pest-control/?utm_source=openai))

**Reliance Pest Control**  
Based in Toledo, Ohio, Reliance Pest Control provides dependable residential and commercial pest control services to the Greater Toledo area, including Maumee, Perrysburg, Whitehouse, Bowling Green, and surrounding communities. Their experienced exterminators are licensed pest inspectors and pesticide applicators. ([allreliancepest.com](https://allreliancepest.com/pest-control/?utm_source=openai))

When selecting a pest control provider, consider factors such as the company's experience, range of services, customer reviews, and their approach to safety and environmental responsibility. It's advisable to contact these companies directly to discuss your specific needs and ensure they offer services in your exact location.
